content:
Nadia Gomez: Heads up — HelixCare sent back a 60-question vendor risk form and flagged embeddings retention as 'contractual blocker' for renewal. We need a concise reply ASAP.
Tom Reynolds: Oof. Can someone confirm our standard retention and whether we offer an option to anonymize embeddings?
Clara Huang: Standard: embeddings retained 365 days by default for hosted customers; Dedicated/Private can opt for 30 days or on-request purge via API. We don't automatically pseudonymize vectors; we can add a process note about hashing identifiers before embedding.
Jae Park: For SOC2 scoping they asked if non-prod is excluded. We should say: "SOC2 includes any environment that processes customer PII or production-equivalent workloads; ephemeral staging that does not receive customer PII is excluded." Is that accurate?
Nadia Gomez: Yes. Also add the support path: if they need BYOK we can discuss Dedicated or Private with KMS integration; hosted requires provider-managed keys.
Tom Reynolds: I'm going to draft a 3-bullet reply: 1) scope note 2) retention + anonymization options 3) BYOK/kms path and who to contact.
Clara Huang: Add a sample API purge request snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings/purge
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Body: {"tenant_id":"acme-tenant","created_before":"2025-09-01T00:00:00Z"}
```
security-bot: Created ticket CS-4599 (helixcare-embeddings-blocker) assigned to @Nadia and @Jae. SLA 72h.
Nadia Gomez: Thanks team — I'll send the reply and loop in renewal AE to avoid churn risk.
thread_text: HelixCare vendor risk form: embeddings retention blocker and SOC2 scope clarification
